title: rest-o-matic config
description: A rest-o-matic config file. Values written !locked "..." or !plain "..." are strings.

max_concurrent.description: How many jobs may run at the same time on this host. Defaults to 2.

policies.description: Named schedules and retention, referred to by a job's policy.

repositories.description: Named restic repositories, referred to by a job's repositories.

^x-.description: Not read by rest-o-matic; a place to define YAML anchors.

retention.description: How many snapshots of each period to keep. Only the periods given are applied.

hourly.description: How many hourly snapshots to keep

daily.description: How many daily snapshots to keep

weekly.description: How many weekly snapshots to keep

monthly.description: How many monthly snapshots to keep

yearly.description: How many yearly snapshots to keep

schedule.description: When the job is due: once per hour, day (from 00:00 UTC) or week (from Sunday 00:00 UTC).

backend.description: The kind of storage. It must agree with the url's prefix: local takes a filesystem path, every other backend a url beginning with its name and a colon (rest-server uses rest:). Another value is passed on with a warning.

url.description: The repository, exactly as restic's -r takes it, such as /mnt/nas/restic or s3:https://s3.example.com/bucket/path.

password.description: The repository password, in plain text or written !locked "..." (see rest-o-matic secret lock).

password_file.description: A file holding the repository password.

password_command.description: A command that prints the repository password.

env.description: Extra environment variables for restic, such as a cloud provider's credentials. Any value may be written !locked "..."; one that isn't secret may be marked !plain "...".

paths.description: Files and directories to back up. A leading ~ is your home directory.

hooks.description: Commands run around each run of the job.

before.description: Run in order before the backup. If one fails, the backup doesn't run.

after.description: Run after the backup: a list (the same as always), or by outcome.

oneOf.description: Run every time, even after a failure.

always.description: Run every time, first, even after a failure. A failing command fails the job.

success.description: Run when the job fully succeeded.

policy.description: The name of the policy that sets the schedule and retention.

retention.description: Overrides the policy's retention, period by period.
Overrides the retention for this repository only, period by period.

tags.description: Tags added to every snapshot, besides the job's name.

read_as.description: How the source is read: direct (the default), or podman-unshare for files written by rootless Podman containers (Linux only).

notify.description: Commands that report on every job.

failure.description: Run when a job starts failing, then at most once a day while it keeps failing.

recovery.description: Run on the first success after a failure.
